Name: Furbys Alternate Apples and Junimo Portraits
Author: Furbling
Description:
Some new portraits for the junimo NPCs from Stardew Valley Expanded, Apples and Peaches, as well as the junimo vendors in the forest. Also includes edits of the overworld sprites to match the new colors and edit the position of the cheek blush. I haven't been able to test the peaches or applessad sprites in game, but as the regular apples sprites are loading I'm hopeful I did the paths correctly.

These are edited from the original sprites included in SVE, just edited to my tastes. Thank you to the original authors for making Apples :)

Update 04/16/24: Added portraits to the vendors, slight name change
